include.description:
Omit for facts only. `conversation` pages the stored turns in full. `turns` pages them as
summaries (index, role, tsMs, text up to 200 chars, toolCalls, toolErrors, model) with no
tool input or result and no provided skills (a call whose failure is not recorded adds
toolErrorsUnknown), and the answer holds only the session's id, cli, branch and timing, its
story, the reasons for those and the page. Not both.

limit.description: Turns to return (1–200). Defaults to 20, or 1 for a jump.

sessionId.description: A CodeSense session id or the CLI's native session id. Names the subject, not the caller.

toolUseId.description: Jump to the turn containing this CLI-native tool call id.

turn.description: Jump to this zero-based turn index; exclusive with cursor and toolUseId.

members.name: storyChanges

cursor.description:
nextCursor from the previous page with the same story. Stale cursors are refused.
`pages.<array>.cursor` resumes a truncated array.

include.description: Opt in to introduced-line attribution for the current commit page (private reads only).

limit.description:
Commit page size (default 100, at most 500). Every array pages by limit; tasks are
oldest first. Totals cover every commit (`files` adds landed-diff paths).

only.description:
Return only these arrays (plus `totals`) and compute only what they need: `tasks`,
`sessions` and `reviews` never read git. Omit for every array. Without a git array
(`commits`, `prs`, `branches`, `worktrees`, `actual`) `totals.commits`, `files` and `lines`
are null, with `unavailable.commits`, `files` and `lines` saying why, and a cursor is stale.

items.description: An array a read can be narrowed to (`only`).

oneOf.description:
The story's complete review-round markers: round, phase, scope, skill, subjectRev,
high, medium, low, dismissed, converged and reportedAt. From the records, no git.

storyId.description: Story id, for example DEMO-29. Next: session_read, task_read for one session or task.

cursor.description:
nextCursor from the previous page with the same story. Stale cursors are refused.
`pages.<array>.cursor` resumes a truncated array.

include.description: Opt in to introduced-line attribution for the current commit page (private reads only).

limit.description:
Commit page size (default 100, at most 500). Every array pages by limit; tasks are
oldest first. Totals cover every commit (`files` adds landed-diff paths).

only.description:
Return only these arrays (plus `totals`) and compute only what they need: `tasks`,
`sessions` and `reviews` never read git. Omit for every array. Without a git array
(`commits`, `prs`, `branches`, `worktrees`, `actual`) `totals.commits`, `files` and `lines`
are null, with `unavailable.commits`, `files` and `lines` saying why, and a cursor is stale.

items.description: An array a read can be narrowed to (`only`).

oneOf.description:
The story's complete review-round markers: round, phase, scope, skill, subjectRev,
high, medium, low, dismissed, converged and reportedAt. From the records, no git.

storyId.description: Story id, for example DEMO-29. Next: session_read, task_read for one session or task.
